svg.text: Now live in Outlook across ten mailboxes and four brands. The workforce reads, sorts and
matches every email, then prepares the next step. One mailbox already acts on its own; the
rest stay in shadow mode — proposing, never changing anything until you sign off.
EVERY EMAIL GOES THROUGH FIVE STEPS
Shadow = runs behind the scenes; visible only in the Bulk Review tool, nothing in Outlook. Dry-run = the label already appears in Outlook, but the
workforce doesn't act on it automatically yet. Live = it acts on its own. States reflect current config — verify before sending.
Sales mailbox acts on its own
Sorts, labels and routes mail — you still send
Every mail gets an automatic subject label.
